name: 95050 · Santa Clara, CA
findings: ZIP 95050 (Santa Clara) has 188 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95050 (Santa Clara) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95050 (Santa Clara) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
